name: AION 2 (North America)
note: AION 2's servers sit behind Cloudflare, so a ping reaches Cloudflare's nearest edge (Sydney), not the server. ExitLag routes AION 2 to US Phoenix, so this is the time to Oracle Cloud's Phoenix region by your normal route. (objectstorage.us-phoenix-1 now resolves to an Australian cache and doesn't answer.)
